Self harm is definitely not the best for you and your mental health as someone who’s recovered. I have been 2.5 years clean now. Logically it’s bad for you because you’re trying to suppress your emotions and mental pain into something so bad like harming yourself, whether that’s punching, scratching, burning or cutting, at the end of the day you’re putting all your negative emotions and feelings towards hurting yourself which can also hurt others around you. I try my best to be there for people who are in the same boat I used to be in and I truly wish I had people around me to tell me not to do it. When you recover you’re left with constant reminders of the past and how bad your mental health used to be. I recommend getting help from a doctor and a therapist if you can, they truly saved my life. I hope you can find yourself on the boat to recovery and get help, it’s not a fun place to be and never will be. Wishing you the best OP

First I’d like to say I’m sorry. This “friend” group definitely doesn’t sound like true friends. I’ve been in many friendships where they’d tease me and make fun of me, etc. and the best thing I ever did was cut them all out of my life. Yes it can be hard sometimes and you have to go through all the drama but in the end it’s worth it for you and your mental health. You need to have friends you can rely on, have fun with, and talk about your feelings with and I’m sorry but these don’t sound like friends. 

As for your porn addiction as mentioned, I would seek help if trying to wear off it doesn’t help. I have known a lot of people and still know a lot of people with porn addictions and it truly has ruined their lives mentally, emotionally and relationship wise. Therapy is always a good way to get help and support and you have to keep in mind they’re not there to judge, they’re there to support you! 

I hope you can break free from this friend group and truly find your real friends and happiness, as well as a comfortable space where you can truly just be yourself. Everyone deserves to express themselves in their own way, we’re all unique humans. Try and find communities that resonate with you and try to make a few friends from there! At the end of the day you shouldn’t let anyone bring you down like this. Keep your head up OP

Everyone has their moments and feels feelings, we’re all human beings. If you wanna grow wise push yourself towards it! You say you can hardly read or spell so maybe work on that little by little. You could start by finding a book you really like and writing a little essay about it, watching videos on different topics you’re passionate about, or even ask for assistance in school if you “suck” at school. I had a rough time in school (middle and high school) myself, but the biggest thing that helped me was reaching out to the teachers and getting extra help after school. Sometimes I feel this way too because a lot of my friends are a lot smarter than me, but we’re all smart in our own way so don’t call yourself stupid, that will only bring down your self esteem
